This spell allows you to heal your target or yourself for 287. Energy Cost: 60

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Defensive Target

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Heals your defensive target for 117” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:healing-touch-i)

The Paladin has a Healing Touch line of its own, held separately here. It is a weaker ability rather than the same one: at matching levels this Cleric version heals between 10% and 23% more.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Defensive Target

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Heals your defensive target for 334” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:healing-touch-ii)

The Paladin has a Healing Touch line of its own, held separately here. It is a weaker ability rather than the same one: at matching levels this Cleric version heals between 10% and 23% more.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Heals your defensive target for 568” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:healing-touch-iii)

The Paladin has a Healing Touch line of its own, held separately here. It is a weaker ability rather than the same one: at matching levels this Cleric version heals between 10% and 23% more.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

The Paladin has a Healing Touch line of its own, held separately here. It is a weaker ability rather than the same one: at matching levels this Cleric version heals between 10% and 23% more.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Notes

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Heals your defensive target for 1085” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:healing-touch-v)

The Paladin has a Healing Touch line of its own, held separately here. It is a weaker ability rather than the same one: at matching levels this Cleric version heals between 10% and 23% more.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Spiritual Guardian IV

Cleric · Level 38

Effect

Rescues your defensive target from an incoming attack, causing the offender to target you for 2 seconds and your defensive target gains 50% spiritual resistance as well as a rune that absorbs 90% damage from the next hit. This resistance lasts 60 sec while the rune fades in 5 sec. The same opponent may only be target-forced once every 30 sec.
